title: ModelRunReport
description: Standardized contract for model training and evaluation runs (Tiny Aya M0-M3).

model_id.description: Identifier of model candidate (e.g. M0-raw, M1-plain-lora, M2-gated-lora, M3-safetune)

model_name.description: Base foundation model architecture (e.g. Tiny Aya Global 3B)

dataset_manifest_hash.description: SHA-256 digest of verified dataset manifest

config_hash.description: SHA-256 digest of hyperparameter training config

checkpoint_hash.description: SHA-256 digest of output checkpoint adapter weights

checkpoint_path.description: Relative storage path to adapter safetensors

evaluation_refs.description: IDs of AuditKIT / SafeTune evaluation artifacts

is_mock.description: True if output was generated by a mock worker stub
